intro: Personalize the visual aesthetic of your Windows system. Switch between light and dark modes, adjust transparency effects, and choose the picture on the desktop.

⚠️ Setting Persistence

Settings found in the Customizations view are not persistent. Winhance applies these changes once, but it does not use background tasks to re-apply them if they are changed later by Windows or by you manually.

groups.Background: The picture on the desktop and how it fits the screen. Winhance offers Windows' own pictures, keeps the one already set, or takes one you browse for; the Windows pictures and their file paths are listed below.
